title: Operator lists and inspects what has been recorded
asA: operator who wants to see what the agent has logged this session
iWant: to run rcf feedback list (and rcf feedback status) to see pending entries and their state without triggering any submission
soThat: I can decide by hand what to do with the log, and doctor can report the same counts on demand

acceptanceCriteria.description: rcf feedback list prints one line per pending entry (id, target, symptom class, severity, one-line title) sorted by recordedAt ascending; --all includes submitted, deferred, discarded, bundled entries with their status column; --json emits a stable machine-readable shape. Neither invocation touches the network or writes to entries.jsonl.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fixture project with three entries of mixed status
acceptanceCriteria.when: the operator runs rcf feedback list and then rcf feedback list --all --json
acceptanceCriteria.then: default output shows only pending entries in order; --all includes every state; --json parses to an array whose length equals total entries; no file mutation, no network calls

acceptanceCriteria.description: rcf feedback status prints counts by status, the opt-out state (from rcf/feedback-settings.json or RCF_FEEDBACK_ASK env), a destination table for every applied blueprint (rows: target, resolved repo or unresolved with reason, visibility hint), and gh availability (present, authed, absent, unknown). --json emits the same as machine-readable object. The status shape is the one the SessionStart hook and doctor both consume.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fixture project with several blueprints applied and gh present
acceptanceCriteria.when: the operator runs rcf feedback status --json
acceptanceCriteria.then: the JSON carries counts, optOut boolean, destinations[] with target/repo/visibility, and gh { present, authed } fields; the text form prints the same as a readable summary
